description: The workflow document contract: zod schemas for workflow JSON and API-format prompts, load-time validation with link repair, the supported workflow-bearing file formats, subgraph flattening, and model-requirement extraction from workflow documents. Open workflows, the workflow store, and graph entity implementation remain external.

characterizationScenarios.name: Workflow schemas accept valid workflow and API documents and reject malformed ones
Load-time validation reports schema errors and repairs broken links
Flattening and model-requirement extraction walk nested subgraphs

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
Serialized workflow JSON accepted by the existing schemas stays accepted so saved workflows, templates, and shared links keep loading.

workflowSchema typing against litegraph serialisation, LGraph, and widget types, and useWorkflowValidation calling the toast store and linkFixer, remain visible as coupling debt; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
